## This week ...

As projects grow, they need more structure. We look at some helpers that make day-to-day work easier (`reprex`, `air`, `usethis`), at making tables, and at the tools that keep a growing project in order: build systems like `make` and `targets`, reproducible package environments with `renv`, and R packages as a way to bundle functions and data.

## Required Reading

- @wickham23:_r_packag. [Read the text online](https://r-pkgs.org). Read the [Introduction](https://r-pkgs.org/introduction.html) and [The Whole Game](https://r-pkgs.org/whole-game.html), which builds a small package from start to finish.
- @landau22:_r. [Read the manual online](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/). Read the [Walkthrough](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/walkthrough.html) chapter.
- The `renv` [introductory vignette](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/articles/renv.html).

## Examples

[This week's example](/example/11-example-buildenvs.qmd) builds a small
`targets` pipeline in a temporary directory, runs it, and then changes one step
to show that `targets` rebuilds only what is out of date.
